governance.note: Rule 13 [R-MEASURED] admissibility of the new mechanism: every input is either the model's OWN P0 solution (run pattern, duals) or a forward-derivable physical constant, so nothing is pinned to a NYISO outcome and the whole mechanism regenerates for a forecast year and responds to changed conditions. The two min_load_frac values and two min_run_hours are measured unit CONDUCT (CAMPD 2023-2025), the class of input rule 13 explicitly admits; they were never swept, and the reconstructed CC min-load 0.523 is corroborated OUT OF SAMPLE by ERCOT's independently published 0.574. Rule 25 [R-ISO-SCOPE] is satisfied by construction: the NYISO values live in NYISO-only fields and the ERCOT bridge's 0.574 was NOT transplanted - the agreement is a check, not a source. ARM D CONTRAST, recorded because it is the rule-1 case in its purest form: a probe arming td_loss_factor=0.0251 flips the same C1 cell AND improves C3c more than any arm here (2025 tail 9h -> 18h), but breaks C5a (2025 CO2 +8.1 -> +14.2 %, out of band). If that extra 3.7 TWh were real load the fleet serves, burning it would not push measured-plant-rate CO2 four points past its band - independent physical corroboration of docs/nyiso-td-loss-resolution-2026-06.md, whose Gold Book Table I-2 Note 1 already established that the served demand is loss-INCLUSIVE. The better-fitting arm is the wrong answer, and this keeper deliberately does not use it.
governance.residuals_note: SCORED EFFECT vs the de-designated nyiso-81 keeper. C1 fuel-mix - NYISO's load-bearing FAIL - CLOSES: the 2023 CC_REGULAR cell walks -4.11 (same-HEAD control) -> -3.32 (limbs off) -> -3.20 (+physical bar) -> -2.89 (+econ+min-run at class tables) -> -2.78 TWh here, against a +/-2.94 band. It closes with td_loss_factor still 0.0, which is the OPPOSITE of what nyiso-86 sec 2.1 expected: that section nominated td_loss_factor as C1's instrument, and the cell closed instead by re-timing gas the model was already free to dispatch. The margin is thin (~0.16 of +/-2.94 TWh) and is recorded as such. Also improved: C3a 2024/2025 -5.5/-6.7 % -> -3.2/-4.7 %, C5a 2025 +8.1 -> +7.6 %, C8 2024 ST_GAS forced share 36.2 -> 31.9 % (still grounded above budget), and the ungated nyiso-86 sec 3 interchange defect moves monotonically toward the measurement from BOTH ends (imports hod01-03 3,048 -> 2,797 vs actual 2,596; hod16-18 2,381 -> 2,713 vs 2,857; within-month r +0.072 -> +0.108) under a mechanism that touches no seam wiring. More online capacity at the peak means more headroom under the $258 mainland roof; C3c is roof-blocked (nyiso-85 sec 7d), not tightness-blocked, and a structurally-correct commitment mechanism stays in even when a residual moves the wrong way. entries.name: nyiso_gas_commitment_bridge (min_load_frac + min_run_hours)
entries.source: ALL FOUR values read from ONE frozen derive artifact, data/raw/_processed-legacy/campd_gas_commitment_params_NYISO.csv (scripts/data/derive_campd_gas_commitment_params.py, EPA CAMPD unit-level hourly grossLoad 2023-2025, 78 units). min_load_frac = the capacity-weighted p50 across units of each unit's own LSL/HSL ratio, where HSL = p99.5 of pooled load and LSL = p5 of online-hour load (the WP-3 loading-when-on construction + the derive_cc_committed_pct.py p5-of-online minimum-stable statistic). min_run_hours = the capacity-weighted p50 of the measured run-length distribution (CC p25/p50/p75 = 11/21/133 h; ST_GAS 3/13/89 h). NYISO publishes no 60-Day-DAM equivalent of the ERCOT LSL/HSL disclosure, which is why the ratio is reconstructed from the meter; the reconstructed CC value 0.523 lands within 9 % of ERCOT's independently PUBLISHED cap-weighted p50 of 0.574 — an outside cross-check that the construction is not self-referential.
entries.note: ZERO residual identification: no value was chosen for its effect on a price or volume residual, and none was swept. The capacity weighting is forced by what the parameter does (a min-run constraint floors committed MW, not committed unit-count) and is the same weighting min_load_frac uses. The min-run values DISAGREE with the published class tables in OPPOSITE directions — CC 21 h is an increase over the table's 5-10 h, ST_GAS 13 h a decrease from its 24-48 h — which is itself evidence the values follow the measurement rather than a residual: a residual-fitted pair would not move against a published table in one class and with it in the other. Caveat recorded: an OBSERVED run length is an upper-ish bound on a minimum-run CONSTRAINT, so the low percentiles bound it from the side the constraint lives on; the p50 is the deliberate, documented choice and re-derives ONLY when the CAMPD vintages update (rule 23 [R-FROZEN-DERIVE]). The mechanism's other inputs add no parameters at all: min-down and startup cost come from the published NREL/SR-5500-55433 class tables the model already used, the DA horizon is the tariff-cited DA_COMMITMENT_HORIZON_HOURS=24, and the restart inequality is priced at the model's OWN P0 duals. n_residual UNCHANGED at 6.
